description: Logistic energy head of CPEG: E = w_text*s0 + sum_i w_probe_i*(s_i - s0) + intercept; s = fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-large logit.

feature_meaning.w_object_swap: s4 - s0, people replaced by 'a computer program'

precision_note: Weights as committed (4 decimals). The deployed head kept full precision; with 4-decimal weights E can differ by about 1e-3, which matters only for requests within that distance of a threshold.

fit.rule: logistic regression, lbfgs, C 1, class_weight balanced, sample weight = row weight, fitted on the validation split (out-of-fold logits, 5 folds, seed 42, for the bands)

encoder.rows_mode: each unique row once, loss weighted by its repeat weight and label balance
